overview.description: Integrate the Photo-Macros meal tracking application as a new "/nutrition" feature within Body-Metrics-Tracker

compatibility.item: Both repos use identical tech stack: React, Express, Drizzle ORM, PostgreSQL, Tailwind, shadcn/ui, React Query, Wouter
Both use same project structure: client/, server/, shared/
Body-Metrics-Tracker uses patientId (linked to userId), Photo-Macros uses userId directly - need to adapt

task.title: Add nutrition_goals table
task.details: Create table for per-patient daily macro targets: - id: serial PK - patientId: integer FK → patients.id (NOT userId like source repo) - calories: integer (default 2000) - protein: integer (default 150g) - carbs: integer (default 200g) - fat: integer (default 65g) - updatedAt: timestamp

task.title: Add meals table
task.details: Create table for logged meals: - id: serial PK - patientId: integer FK → patients.id - imageUrl: text (optional, for AI-analyzed photos) - mealType: text ('breakfast' | 'lunch' | 'dinner' | 'snack') - date: date (YYYY-MM-DD) - createdAt: timestamp

task.title: Add meal_items table
task.details: Create table for individual food items within meals: - id: serial PK - mealId: integer FK → meals.id (cascade delete) - name: text - quantity: integer (default 1) - unit: text (default 'serving') - calories: integer - protein: integer - carbs: integer - fat: integer

task.title: Add Drizzle relations
task.details: - mealsRelations: meal → many meal_items, meal → one patient - mealItemsRelations: meal_item → one meal - nutritionGoalsRelations: nutrition_goal → one patient

task.title: Add Zod schemas and TypeScript types
task.details: - insertNutritionGoalSchema (omit id, updatedAt, patientId) - insertMealSchema (omit id, createdAt, patientId) - insertMealItemSchema (omit id) - NutritionGoal, Meal, MealItem types - MealWithItems composite type - AnalyzeImageResponse type for AI results

task.title: Run database migration
task.details: Push schema changes to PostgreSQL

task.title: Add nutrition API definitions to shared/routes.ts
Extend IStorage interface
task.details: Add methods: - getNutritionGoal(patientId, userId): Promise<NutritionGoal | undefined> - upsertNutritionGoal(patientId, data, userId): Promise<NutritionGoal> - getMeals(patientId, date, userId): Promise<MealWithItems[]> - createMeal(patientId, data, userId): Promise<MealWithItems> - deleteMeal(mealId, userId): Promise<void>

task.title: Implement DatabaseStorage nutrition methods
task.details: Implementation notes: - Use verifyOwnership pattern for all methods - createMeal uses transaction: insert meal → insert items → return with items - getMeals uses db.query with nested relations (items) - deleteMeal verifies ownership before deletion

phase.name: Phase 4: Backend Routes
phase.description: Add nutrition API endpoints to server/routes.ts

task.title: Add nutrition goals endpoints
task.details: GET /api/nutrition/goals - Get patient's macro targets (create defaults if missing) POST /api/nutrition/goals - Upsert macro targets

task.title: Add meals CRUD endpoints
task.details: GET /api/nutrition/meals?date=YYYY-MM-DD - List meals for date POST /api/nutrition/meals - Create meal with items DELETE /api/nutrition/meals/:id - Delete meal

Add image upload endpoint (if not using existing)

phase.description: Create React Query hooks for nutrition feature

task.title: Create use-nutrition.ts hook
task.details: Export hooks: - useNutritionGoals() - GET goals with default values - useUpdateNutritionGoals() - mutation to update goals - useMeals(date: string) - GET meals for date - useCreateMeal() - mutation to create meal - useDeleteMeal() - mutation to delete meal - useAnalyzeImage() - mutation for AI analysis

phase.name: Phase 7: Frontend Pages
phase.description: Create nutrition pages and integrate into router

task.title: Create Nutrition.tsx dashboard page
task.details: Main nutrition dashboard showing: - Date picker (default: today) - 4 MacroRings: Calories, Protein, Carbs, Fat - Summary stats: Burned (--), Eaten, Remaining - Today's Meals list with MealCards - "Log Meal" CTA button - Link to nutrition settings/goals

task.title: Create LogMeal.tsx page
task.details:
3-step meal logging flow: 1. UPLOAD: File picker for meal photo 2. ANALYZE: Loading state while AI processes 3. REVIEW: Show detected foods, allow edits, select meal type, save
State machine: 'upload' → 'analyze' → 'review' On save: createMeal mutation → redirect to /nutrition

task.title: Create NutritionSettings.tsx page (optional)
task.details: Page to edit daily macro goals: - Form with: Calories, Protein, Carbs, Fat inputs - Save button - Could be integrated into existing Profile page instead

task.title: Add routes to App.tsx
task.details: Add protected routes: <Route path="/nutrition"> <ProtectedRoute><Nutrition /></ProtectedRoute> </Route> <Route path="/nutrition/log"> <ProtectedRoute><LogMeal /></ProtectedRoute> </Route> <Route path="/nutrition/settings"> <ProtectedRoute><NutritionSettings /></ProtectedRoute> </Route>
